integrity: Exact symbolic derivation and polyhedral volume identities supplemented by a standalone standard-library rational-arithmetic checker; independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: The metric theorem and volume law concern one-axis stretched Euclidean three-dimensional cross-polytopes; no claims about triaxial deformations, arbitrary polytopes, or historical priority completeness. The companion bipolar-polytope paper was available only via abstract.
title: Axial anisotropy induces a sharp orthogonal-kernel phase transition in octahedra
